verdict.reasons: Core defects: The candidate presents a mixed irrigation family by including a clearly visible round, black coil of tubing that is distinct from the authorized drip-tape product. This installed tubing acts as a 'wrong' product, causing the observed_family to classify as mixed and the product_count to fail (expected 1). Technical evidence mismatch: The article discusses flat '20cm tape' with localized wetting, but the visible black tubing is round and standard drip line/hose, which contradicts the specific product geometry described. The round coil placed flat on the soil near the seedling is physically implausible as standard drip-tape installation. Minor Advisory: The Iranian text on the carton label appears partially garbled/misspelled, but the core 'AFP' identity and English text are clear.

focused_physical_review.reason: The white-and-blue AFP package is sitting directly in the soil with clumps touching its base, so there is no broad clear soil gap. An uninstalled black drip tape coil is visible to the right of the package; while the line does not touch the carton, the coil itself is a distinct extra object. A white label or tape strip protrudes from the bottom right corner of the package carton.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
